debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (use only for troubleshooting).

sqlite_db_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file storing subscriber and location data.

msc_listen_addr.description: IP address on which the HLR listens for MSC connections (A-bis interface).

auth_policy.description: Authentication algorithm used for SIM/USIM verification. Choose from: comp128v1 (default), comp128v2, comp128v3, or none.

apn.description: Default APN used for subscriber lookups in GPRS/IMS contexts.

max_msc_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections allowed to the HLR from MSCs.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for MSC connections (requires valid certificate and key).

tls_cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format). Only used if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format). Only used if TLS is enabled.

log_levels.description: Per-subsystem logging levels (e.g., DHLR, DIUC, DMNCC, DSP). Use: 'none', 'error', 'notice', 'info', 'debug'.

sgsn_ggsn_addr.description: IP address of the GGSN used for APN resolution (e.g., in S4/IMS scenarios).

sgsn_apn.description: APN used for GPRS context setup (e.g., for IMS or data services).

gsup_servers.description: List of GSUP peer HLRs for inter-HLR communication (e.g., roaming).

name.description: Friendly name for the GSUP peer.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the GSUP peer.

cli_telnet_port.description: Port for CLI access via Telnet (local management only).

cli_telnet_password.description: Optional password for CLI access via Telnet. Leave empty for no password (not recommended in production).
